en.title: Farewell to “topology hell” and “texture duds”: Tencent Hunyuan launches Hy3D 3.6, with native 3D generation taking direct aim at professional pipeline pain points

en.title: Can general-purpose large models "break through" physical AI? He Xiaopeng offers a sobering answer: the constraints of the physical world can't be papered over with parameters
en.reason: At XPeng Tech Day, XPeng Group chairman and CEO He Xiaopeng argued that physical-world AI faces stricter constraints than the digital world, and general large models alone cannot solve all physical AI challenges, dampening the parameter race.

sources.title_original: OpenAI countersues Apple over trade secret theft and alleged coercion of shared suppliers
sources.summary:
OpenAI is suing Apple in a California court, accusing it of trade secret theft and of coercing shared suppliers. The countersuit follows Apple's own lawsuit from the summer. Just two years ago, the two companies teamed up to bring ChatGPT to the iPhone. Now OpenAI is building its own devices to compete directly with Apple.

en.reason: OpenAI's countersuit against Apple in California alleges trade secret theft and coercion of shared suppliers, two years after the pair brought ChatGPT to iPhone and as OpenAI builds rival devices after buying Jony Ive's io for $6.4 billion.

sources.title_original: Banned Nvidia Blackwell chips turn up in a Shanghai data center linked to Alice Huang, Bloomberg reports
sources.summary:
Two Chinese companies installed Nvidia's powerful Blackwell chips at a Shanghai data center linked to Alice Huang, according to a Bloomberg investigation. A serial number led Bloomberg to Taiwanese manufacturer Gigabyte. Exporting these chips to China without a US license is illegal.

sources.title_en: Rockstar's AI dilemma: Can GTA 6's staggered release model survive coding agents?
sources.title_original: Rockstar's AI dilemma: Can GTA 6's staggered release model survive coding agents?
sources.summary:
More than 40 projects are working to bring a leaked Xbox build of GTA 6 to PC through reverse engineering just days after its $3.79 billion record console launch. AI coding agents like Claude Code are speeding up the process so much that an early unofficial multiplayer mode is already running. Rockstar's delayed PC business model is coming under pressure.
More than 40 projects are working to bring a leaked Xbox build of GTA 6 to PC through reverse engineering just days after its $3.79 billion re

en.reason: After GTA 6's $3.79 billion console launch, over 40 reverse-engineering projects are using Claude Code and other AI agents to port a leaked Xbox build to PC, with an unofficial multiplayer mode already hitting 25–30fps challenging Rockstar's delayed PC strategy.

stories.title: 打破能力天花板：AI 时代的「野心与认知」方法论 ​01 在商业领域有一个普遍共识：创业者的上限，往往取决于其野心与认知的上限。进入大模型时代后，这一规律正延伸至每一个普通个体。面对相同的底层模型、同样的交互界面与订阅成本，不同使用者产出的结果却呈现出巨大鸿沟。当医学、数学等前沿领域的专家已经借助大模型推动科研突破时，绝大多数职场人仍停留在「帮我润色一封邮件」的浅层交互中。 Anthropic 旗下 Claude 工程主管 Felix…

en.title:
Breaking the capability ceiling: a methodology of ambition and cognition for the AI era

01 In business, there is a widely held view: a founder's ceiling is often set by the ceiling of their ambition and cognition.
en.reason: Anthropic Claude engineering lead Felix Rieseberg's 5-million-view post examines why experts in medicine and math use the same models and subscriptions to drive research breakthroughs while most professionals only polish emails, and sets out an ambition-and-cognition methodology.

en.title: States sue SpaceX to stop Grok from generating child sexual abuse imagery and revenge porn
en.reason: Virginia Attorney General Jay Jones and Oregon's Dan Rayfield are suing SpaceX, arguing X's Grok can turn a single photo into nonconsensual sexualized imagery and CSAM while marketing its missing safeguards as "spicy mode.

stories.title: 「AI 会不会毁灭人类」这个问题，卡巴斯基的 CEO 给了个更现实的答案：短期不会，但它正在变成黑客手里的工具。 尤金·卡巴斯基（Eugene Kaspersky）在接受采访时说，AI 在短期内不会像科幻电影那样统治人类，可它带来的安全风险已经远超他此前的预期。 最核心的变化是「智能体」。过去语言模型只是个会聊天的框，只要不接触关键开关，就出不了大事；现在攻击者可以把权限交给 AI 智能体，让它自己去执行一连串攻击动作，传统防御体系会…

en.title: On the question of whether AI will destroy humanity, Kaspersky's CEO offered a more grounded answer: not in the near term, but it is becoming a tool in the hands of hackers.

01 NVIDIA reportedly indefinitely suspends AI server chip shipments to four Southeast Asian countries

en.title: DoorDash uses AI agents to cut grocery reorder latency from 16 seconds to 2 seconds
en.reason: DoorDash precomputes 90-day purchase cycles with batch LLM inference and deterministic validation to cut grocery reorder latency from 16 seconds to 2 seconds, while real-time catalog parsing and an editable shopping interface keep selections current and reportedly double shopping-list views and lift order conversion about 34%.

en.reason: Running Inkling 2 Mini in vLLM on a single GB10 reached 101 tok/s, and the Hacker News discussion weighs that throughput against commentators' concerns about output quality.

primary_item.recommend_reason_zh: 在 GB10 上仅调 vLLM，Inkling 2 Mini 就达到单请求 101 tok/s、四并发 195.7 tok/s，并保住 131,072-token 上下文。

en.reason: Running Inkling 2 Mini on a single GB10 in vLLM reaches 101 tok/s for one request and 195.7 tok/s across four concurrent requests, with a 9.7-second 32K prefill and the full 131,072-token context preserved.

en.title: Stop just using AI!
en.reason: A beginner's guide that moves from chatting with ChatGPT and DeepSeek to explaining what an LLM actually is, covering Token, Context Window, Transformer, Attention, Embedding, plus model training, fine-tuning and quantization, and separating the AI field from products like ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude.

sources.summary:
Title: AI 做的小工具，怎样交给同事用？
Published Time: 2026-11-25T10:07:56+00:00
用 AI 写出一个能跑的小工具，现在只需要几分钟。真正的麻烦通常出现在交付那一刻。这个问题也被Claude解决了。
## AI 做出了小工具，怎样让同事下次还能找到它？
在聊天窗口里生成一个 `CSV 检查器`，自己上传测试文件核对无误后，准备发给运营或财务同事用，问题立刻冒出来。把对话链接扔进群里，过两天消息一刷，同事就找不到了。把单文件 HTML 打包发过去，下周规则一改，每个人电脑里留着的版本全都不一样。为了一个轻量工具去买服务器、配域名，成本又太高。
2026 年 11 月 24 日，Anthropic 开始向 Mac 和 Windows 桌面端推送 `Install as app` 测试版。用户在对话里生成可交互的 `Claude artifacts` 并确认可用后，可以直接从分享菜单把它装成桌面应用，获得独立图标和窗口。同日公布的还有 Claude 对长耗时 MCP 任务的支持，用来解决 AI 任务运行时间较长后如何取回结果的问题。AIHOT
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章用同一个 CSV 检查器对比 Claude Install as app 与普通 Web 应用交付，说明 Anthropic 2026 年 11 月 24 日推送的测试版虽能生成独立桌面图标并自动同步，但打开仍需联网登录 Claude 账号。

en.title: How do you hand off a small AI-built tool to your colleagues?
en.summary:
Title: How do you hand off a small tool made by AI to your colleagues?
Published Time: 2026-11-25T10:07:56+00:00
Writing a working small tool with AI now takes only a few minutes. The real trouble usually shows up at the moment of delivery—and Claude has solved this problem too.
## AI made the tool—how do you make sure colleagues can still find it next time?
You generate a `CSV checker` in a chat window, upload a test file yourself, confirm it works, and get ready to send it to operations or finance colleagues. That's when the problems appear. Drop the conversation link into a group chat, and after two days of messages scrolling by, colleagues can't find it. Package and send the single-file HTML, and next week when the rules change, everyone has a different version sitting on their computer. Buying a server and configuring a domain for a lightweight tool is too expensive.
On November 24, 2026, Anthropic began rolling out an `Install as app` beta to Mac and Windows desktop users. After users generate an interactive `Claude artifacts` in a conversation and confirm it works, they can install it directly as a desktop app from the share menu, giving it its own icon and window. Also announced the same day was Claude's support for long-running MCP tasks, addressing how to retrieve results after an AI task has been running for a long time. AIHOT
en.reason: A CSV checker built in a Claude chat can now be installed as a desktop app with its own icon and window via the Install as app beta Anthropic began rolling out to Mac and Windows on November 24, 2026, though it still requires an internet connection and Claude login to open.

Title: Spring AI 2.1 正式发布 ，新增一个重要功能
Published Time: 2026-11-27T01:08:20-06:00
**2026年11月19日，Spring AI 2.1.0 正式发布了。**
Spring AI 2.0 GA 才过去半年，2.1 就来了。而且这一版不是“修修补补”，是**冲着 Agent 落地的深水区去的**。
因为 2.1 解决了一个所有做企业级 Agent 的人都绕不开的问题：**模型调用工具，到底该不该无条件信任？**
> 有些小伙伴在工作中可能遇到过这种情况：你做了一个智能客服 Agent，能查订单、能改地址、能发起退款。测试的时候一切正常，上线之后有一天模型“心情不好”，把一笔不该退的款给退了。你翻日志，发现它确实调了退款工具，参数也是对的，就是判断错了。
这不是模型笨，是**框架层缺少一道“人工确认”的闸门**。
今天这篇文章就专门跟大家一起聊聊Spring AI 2.1，希望对你会有所帮助。
更多项目实战在Java突击队网：susan.net.cn/project
在 2.1 之前，如果你想在工具调用前加一道确认，

en.reason: Spring AI 2.1.0, released November 19, 2026, adds Tool Call Confirmation, which pauses a tool call before execution so the application can return an allow or deny decision, addressing cases such as an agent wrongly issuing a refund.

stories.title: AI 时代，能力好像成为了一种租赁品

sources.title: AI 时代，能力好像成为了一种租赁品
sources.title_zh: AI 时代，能力好像成为了一种租赁品
sources.title_original: AI 时代，能力好像成为了一种租赁品
sources.summary: AI 额度用完的那一刻，才发现自己的一部分“能力”也跟着下线了。作者从一次模型切换后的效率落差讲起，回看自己从搭工作流到让 AI 独立干活的经历：越来越能做事的我们，有多少是真正成长，又有多少只是租来了更强的智能？如果你也习惯了 AI 带来的高效率，这篇随笔值得一读。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Claude Code额度不足被路由到GPT后，Opus 5.5一小时能改完的文档手改花了3个多小时，作者由此反思AI时代能力只是可购买、随时可能失去的租赁品。

en.title: In the AI era, capability seems to have become something you rent
en.summary: The moment the AI quota ran out, part of my own "ability" went offline with it. Starting from the productivity drop after a model switch, the author looks back on the journey from building workflows to letting AI work independently: of all the things we can now do, how much is real growth and how much is just rented intelligence? If you've grown used to the efficiency AI brings, this essay is worth a read.
en.reason: Claude Code ran out of quota and routed work to GPT; a document Opus 5.5 revised in an hour took over three hours by hand, prompting a reflection on AI capability as a purchasable rental that can vanish anytime.

Google may be making Gemini more useful on Pixel phones by introducing task automation capabilities that allow the AI assistant to take actions on your behalf, but OpenAI is c

en.reason: Android Authority's teardown of ChatGPT for Android version 1.2026.328 found it may soon read contacts and call logs, place calls, send and receive texts, control music playback, and read screen content, closing on Gemini, though no launch date is set.

sources.summary:
Gemini's knew a little too much about me which is quite concerning
Gemini's knew a little too much about me which is quite concerning
Gemini's knew a little too much about me which is quite concerning
If you’ve ever wondered whether an AI feature on your phone is doing anything useful, Ben Khalesi has probably asked the same question. He has covered AI and Android for Android Police since 2023, with Pixel, Galaxy, Google’s apps, and the rest of the Android ecosystem never far behind. Ben is a li
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 作者查看 Google Gemini 的 Memory summary 后划出隐私界限：能接受它知道城市和郊区，但不让保留街道地址、每天去的咖啡馆和家人关系，并示范用提示删除这些记忆。

en.reason: After reviewing Google Gemini's Memory summary, the author accepts it knowing their city and suburb but refuses to let it retain their street address, daily café and family relationships, showing prompts to delete those memories.

OpenAI has filed counterclaims accusing Apple of pressuring suppliers to avoid its hardware and using staff contracts to stop engineers joining it.

en.reason: OpenAI's counterclaims filed in San Jose accuse Apple of pressuring suppliers to shun its hardware, using employment contracts to block engineers from joining, and forcing a supplier to move OpenAI work to night shifts.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 作者三个月写的12个AI Skill只剩4个在跑，提交30次、最上心的度量岗死得最早，5个Skill同在9月21日停更，文中附盘点脚本和5条裁人标准，点明没有真值、靠人记着触发的Skill注定吃空饷。

en.title: I Wrote 12 AI Skills. Three Months Later, 8 of Them Are Collecting Paychecks for Doing Nothing
en.reason: Over three months the author built 12 AI Skills but only 4 remain active—defect closure, pixel restoration, code discipline and campaign page development—while 8 stalled, including the most-committed metrics Skill and five that stopped updating on 21 September, with the piece tracing the causes (no ground truth, human-remembered triggers, upkeep exceeding payoff) and offering an inventory script plus 5 criteria for retiring a Skill.

en.title: Where does GLM-5.4 stand? Comparing it with Kimi, DeepSeek, and GPT
en.reason: Zhipu's GLM-5.4 beats GLM-5.3 by a 28-point win-loss margin across 200 real coding scenarios, yet scores 33.2 on the six-app test for seventh place and fixes 28 bugs per run, trailing Kimi on defect repair.
